summary.prose: Building s2 adds one module that turns the daemon's model registry into the models.definitions answer, registers that request, and rebuilds providers.listModels on top of the same answer so the two cannot disagree. The s1 stopgap accessor goes away, and a real-daemon test checks both requests over the socket.

tasks.title: Add the models.definitions projection and register the request
tasks.summary: Add src/daemon/model-definitions.ts with the ModelDefinitionsResult type and modelDefinitions(deps): it projects getModelRegistry() and the validated file's version into the sc3 answer (registry order, aliases always a list, optional fields omitted, rejectedModels on CLI families limited to ids the family does not serve) and marks each listed Ollama model installed from one bounded listing call, omitting installed when the listing rejects. Register 'models.definitions' in buildHandlerRuntime, the method-class table (session) and handler-runtime.test.ts's RECORDED_RPC; refresh the source-inventory digests the edits trip and classify model-definitions.ts if it has boundary sites.
acceptanceChecks: models.definitions returns every sc3 field of a fixture file, with aliases always a list and optional fields omitted

A user-approved model follows the shipped ones with source 'user-approved'; an unlisted rejected id appears only in rejectedModels; a rejected id the file lists is served as shipped and left out of rejectedModels
installed is exact-match true/false, absent on every Ollama model when the lister rejects, and an installed unlisted model does not appear
method-class.test.ts and handler-runtime.test.ts pass with the new method
session-source-inventory.test.ts passes, with model-definitions.ts classified if it has boundary sites

tests.name: model-definitions.test.ts: every sc3 field of a fixture file, aliases always a list, optional fields omitted
model-definitions.test.ts: user-approved after shipped; unlisted rejected id only in rejectedModels; a rejected id the file lists is served as shipped and left out of rejectedModels
model-definitions.test.ts: installed exact-match true/false, absent when the lister rejects, unlisted installed models absent
handler-runtime, method-class and session-source-inventory suites pass with models.definitions registered

tasks.title: Derive providers.listModels from the projection and remove the curated accessor
tasks.summary: Change ListModelsDeps from catalog() to registry() and catalogVersion(); listModels keeps its request/result shape and takes its models from the projection: CLI families without calling the Ollama lister, Ollama as the listed-and-installed models, available:false + [] when the lister rejects. Remove getCuratedCatalog, CuratedCatalog, CatalogModel and CloudProvider from model-catalog.ts, update list-models, model-catalog and model-registry tests, and refresh the source-inventory digests of list-models.ts and model-catalog.ts.
acceptanceChecks: For every family listModels(family).models equals the definitions answer's models for that family (ollama: installed === true) mapped to { id, displayName? }
A CLI-family request never calls the Ollama lister; ollama returns available:false + [] when the lister rejects; invalid params return the unchanged error
No file under src imports getCuratedCatalog, CuratedCatalog or CatalogModel

list-models.test.ts: no file under src imports getCuratedCatalog, CuratedCatalog or CatalogModel
